examples.text_en: The police began an inquiry into the whole case.
examples.text_zh: 警方对这整个案子展开了调查。

examples.text_en: He made a short inquiry about the price of the car.
examples.text_zh: 他简短地询问了那辆车的价格。

examples.text_en: The inquisitive child asked questions about everything at home.
examples.text_zh: 这个好问的孩子在家里什么都问。

examples.text_en: Her inquisitive mind always wanted to know the real truth.
examples.text_zh: 她那追根究底的心思总想知道真正的事实。

examples.text_en: The sea made a great inroad on the low land.
examples.text_zh: 大海慢慢地侵蚀着低洼的土地。

examples.text_en: They fought to stop the inroad of the other group.
examples.text_zh: 他们奋力阻止另一个群体的侵入。

examples.text_en: He had an insatiable need for money and power.
examples.text_zh: 他对金钱和权力有着贪得无厌的需求。

examples.text_en: Her insatiable want to learn never seemed to end.
examples.text_zh: 她那不知足的学习欲望似乎永无止境。

examples.text_en: He asked the man to inscribe her name on the gold cup.
examples.text_zh: 他请那人在金杯上刻下她的名字。

examples.text_en: They will inscribe a few words on the old school wall.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在那面旧校墙上题写几句话。

examples.text_en: The inscription on the old wall was hard to read.
examples.text_zh: 旧墙上的题字很难辨认。

examples.text_en: He found a short inscription on the gold cup.
examples.text_zh: 他在金杯上发现了一行简短的题字。

examples.text_en: His inscrutable face gave away nothing at the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他那高深莫测的表情在会议上没有透露任何信息。

examples.text_en: The ways of the old man were inscrutable to us.
examples.text_zh: 这位老人的行事方式让我们难以捉摸。

examples.text_en: They used an insecticide on the whole field.
examples.text_zh: 他们把杀虫剂用在了整片田地里。

examples.text_en: This insecticide is safe for children and people at home.
examples.text_zh: 这种杀虫剂对家里的孩子和成人都安全。

examples.text_en: The insensate rock felt nothing at all.
examples.text_zh: 那块无生命的岩石毫无感觉。

examples.text_en: He seemed insensate to the pain of those around him.
examples.text_zh: 他似乎对周围人的痛苦无动于衷。

examples.text_en: The insentient earth cannot feel love or pain.
examples.text_zh: 无生命的大地感受不到爱与痛苦。

examples.text_en: Such insentient things have no life in them.
examples.text_zh: 这样无知觉的东西里面没有生命。

examples.text_en: The insider gave us the real story behind the news.
examples.text_zh: 这位知情者把新闻背后的真实情况告诉了我们。

examples.text_en: As an insider, she knew every part of the business.
examples.text_zh: 作为内部人士，她了解这家企业的每一个部分。

examples.text_en: The problem was insidious and grew without anyone seeing.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题很隐蔽，在无人察觉中不断滋长。

examples.text_en: An insidious plan soon took control of the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 一个阴险的计划很快控制了整个团体。

examples.text_en: Her insightful words made the whole group think again.
examples.text_zh: 她富有洞察力的话让整个团队重新思考。

examples.text_en: The book gives an insightful look at human life.
examples.text_zh: 这本书对人的生活提供了富有洞见的看法。

examples.text_en: The gold insignia showed his high place in the group.
examples.text_zh: 那枚金色的徽章显示了他在这团体中的崇高地位。

examples.text_en: They put the insignia of the team on their cars.
examples.text_zh: 他们把队伍的徽章贴在自己的车上。

examples.text_en: The problem was insignificant and easy to forget.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题无关紧要，很容易忘记。

examples.text_en: He felt like an insignificant part of a huge system.
examples.text_zh: 他觉得自己只是庞大体系中微不足道的一部分。

examples.text_en: Her insincerity was easy for everyone to see.
examples.text_zh: 她的虚伪每个人都能看出来。

examples.text_en: He could not stop the insincerity in his words.
examples.text_zh: 他无法掩饰自己话语中的不诚实。

examples.text_en: The food was insipid and gave him no joy.
examples.text_zh: 这食物淡而无味，没有给他带来任何乐趣。

examples.text_en: His insipid talk about his work made her feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那些关于工作的乏味言论让她很难受。

examples.text_en: Her insistence on the truth made the group respect her.
examples.text_zh: 她对事实的坚持让团队敬重她。

examples.text_en: At his insistence, they changed the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 在他的坚持下，他们改变了整个计划。

examples.text_en: He was insistent that we meet again the next day.
examples.text_zh: 他坚持我们第二天再见面。

examples.text_en: Her insistent questions made the man feel quite bad.
examples.text_zh: 她那些迫切的追问让那个男人很不自在。

examples.text_en: They insolate the food in the hot sun.
examples.text_zh: 他们把食物放在炎热的太阳下曝晒。

examples.text_en: Such a way will insolate the land under the hot sun.
examples.text_zh: 这样的做法会让土地在烈日下暴晒。

examples.text_en: His insolence toward the old man made everyone feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 他对老人的傲慢让每个人都感到不舒服。

examples.text_en: She could not take such insolence from a young boy.
examples.text_zh: 她无法忍受一个小男孩如此无礼。

examples.text_en: The insolent stood there and said nothing at all.
examples.text_zh: 那个无礼的人站在那里，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: No one wanted to work with such an insolent.
examples.text_zh: 没有人愿意和这样一个傲慢无礼的人共事。

examples.text_en: The problem seemed insoluble to everyone in the group.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题在团队里每个人看来都无法解决。

examples.text_en: This white thing is insoluble in water or oil.
examples.text_zh: 这种白色的东西不溶于水或油。

examples.text_en: The company was close to insolvency after a hard year.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司在艰难的一年之后濒临破产。

examples.text_en: Their insolvency meant the end of the whole business.
examples.text_zh: 他们的无力偿债意味着整个生意的终结。

examples.text_en: The man was insolvent and could not pay his bills.
examples.text_zh: 那个人无力偿还债务，付不起自己的账单。

examples.text_en: They went insolvent after the market fell that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年市场下跌之后，他们破产了。

examples.text_en: His insomnia kept him up for most of the night.
examples.text_zh: 失眠让他在夜里大部分时间都醒着。

examples.text_en: She had insomnia for a whole week and felt very bad.
examples.text_zh: 她失眠了整整一个星期，感觉非常难受。

examples.text_en: Her insouciance about the future was a problem for the family.
examples.text_zh: 她对未来的无忧无虑成了全家人的一个问题。

examples.text_en: He faced the hard times with insouciance.
examples.text_zh: 他从容不迫地面对艰难的时世。

examples.text_en: The insouciant boy did not care at all.
examples.text_zh: 这个漫不经心的男孩一点也不在乎。

examples.text_en: Her insouciant way made her forget the real risk.
examples.text_zh: 她满不在乎的态度让她忘记了真正的风险。

examples.text_en: Her words helped inspire the whole team to work harder.
examples.text_zh: 她的话激励了整个团队更加努力地工作。

examples.text_en: The beautiful song seemed to inspire everyone in the room.
examples.text_zh: 这首优美的歌似乎鼓舞了房间里的每一个人。

examples.text_en: The instability of the market made everyone feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 市场的不稳定让每个人都感到不安。

examples.text_en: Years of instability left the country poor and small.
examples.text_zh: 多年的动荡让这个国家变得贫穷而弱小。

examples.text_en: They will pay for the car in small installments.
examples.text_zh: 他们将分期付款买下这辆车。

examples.text_en: He missed the first installment and had to pay more.
examples.text_zh: 他错过了第一期付款，不得不付得更多。

examples.text_en: She paid for the old house in small instalments.
examples.text_zh: 她分期付款买下了那栋老房子。

examples.text_en: The final instalment of the money is due today.
examples.text_zh: 最后一期款项今天到期。

examples.text_en: This is a clear instance of the same old problem.
examples.text_zh: 这是同一个老问题的一个明显例子。

examples.text_en: In that instance, he did the right thing at once.
examples.text_zh: 在那种情况下，他立刻做了正确的事。

examples.text_en: The change was instantaneous and we saw it at once.
examples.text_zh: 变化是瞬间发生的，我们立刻就看到了。

examples.text_en: His answer was instantaneous, with no time to think.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答是即时的，根本没有时间思考。

examples.text_en: The group will instate him as the new director.
examples.text_zh: 团队将任命他为新的主管。

examples.text_en: They wanted to instate a woman in that high office.
examples.text_zh: 他们想任命一位女性担任那个要职。

examples.text_en: He tried to instigate the two groups against each other.
examples.text_zh: 他企图煽动这两个群体互相对立。

examples.text_en: She would never instigate such a fight among friends.
examples.text_zh: 她绝不会在朋友之间挑起这样的争斗。

examples.text_en: Good parents instill a love of truth in their children.
examples.text_zh: 好父母会把对真理的热爱灌输给孩子。

examples.text_en: The school tried to instill hope in every young mind.
examples.text_zh: 学校努力在每个年轻人心中灌输希望。

examples.text_en: Her instinctive fear of fire kept her away from it.
examples.text_zh: 她对火的本能恐惧让她远离它。

examples.text_en: He had an instinctive way of knowing what to do.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种本能的方式，知道该做什么。

examples.text_en: The institutes in the city offer many different courses.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市的学院开设许多不同的课程。

examples.text_en: He studied at one of the best institutes in the country.
examples.text_zh: 他在国内最好的学院之一学习。

examples.text_en: The old institution has helped this city for many years.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的机构已经为这座城市服务了许多年。

examples.text_en: It is an old institution in almost every country.
examples.text_zh: 在几乎每个国家，它都是一种古老的制度。

examples.text_en: The problem is not personal but institutional in form.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题不是个人的，而是制度层面的。

examples.text_en: They called for institutional change across the whole system.
examples.text_zh: 他们呼吁在整个体系中进行制度性变革。

examples.text_en: They tried to institutionalize the new rules within a year.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图在一年内把这些新规则制度化。

examples.text_en: It is hard to institutionalize such a way of working.
examples.text_zh: 要把这样一种工作方式制度化很难。

examples.text_en: The practice became institutionalized over many long years.
examples.text_zh: 这种做法在漫长的岁月中逐渐成了惯例。

examples.text_en: Their institutionalized way of life was hard to change.
examples.text_zh: 他们那种已成惯例的生活方式很难改变。

examples.text_en: The institutions of the country are strong and respected.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家的各项制度强大而受人尊重。

examples.text_en: He studied how modern institutions work in a free society.
examples.text_zh: 他研究了现代制度在自由社会中如何运作。

examples.text_en: The instructors were kind and helped us every single day.
examples.text_zh: 这些老师很和善，每天都帮助我们。

examples.text_en: Our instructors at the school know their work very well.
examples.text_zh: 我们学校的老师非常了解自己的工作。

examples.text_en: The young instrumentalist played a beautiful song for us.
examples.text_zh: 这位年轻的乐器演奏家为我们演奏了一首优美的曲子。

examples.text_en: Every instrumentalist in the group had to practice daily.
examples.text_zh: 团里的每位演奏者都必须每天练习。

examples.text_en: The insubordinate man would not follow the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 这个不顺从的男人不愿遵守新规则。

examples.text_en: They called him insubordinate for questioning the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他违抗命令，因为他质疑了这个计划。

examples.text_en: His words were insubstantial and easy to question.
examples.text_zh: 他的话空洞无力，很容易被质疑。

examples.text_en: The old story was insubstantial and had no real facts.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧故事缺乏实质内容，没有真正的事实。

examples.text_en: His insufferable way made him hard to work with.
examples.text_zh: 他那令人难以忍受的态度让人很难和他共事。

examples.text_en: The air in that room was simply insufferable.
examples.text_zh: 那个房间里的空气简直让人无法忍受。

examples.text_en: The insular town knew little about the rest of the world.
examples.text_zh: 这个与世隔绝的小镇对外面的世界知之甚少。

examples.text_en: His insular way of thinking kept him from new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 他保守的思维方式让他无法接受新思想。

examples.text_en: Their insularity made them slow to take new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 他们的保守孤立使他们迟迟不愿接受新思想。

examples.text_en: The insularity of the small town lasted for many years.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇与世隔绝的状态持续了许多年。

examples.text_en: They used a special thing to insulate the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种特殊的东西把整个房间隔离起来。

examples.text_en: You should insulate the house to save money and power.
examples.text_zh: 你应该给房子做好隔热处理，以节省金钱和能源。

examples.text_en: The insulation in the old house was not good at all.
examples.text_zh: 那栋老房子的隔热效果一点也不好。

examples.text_en: They added insulation to the walls of the new house.
examples.text_zh: 他们给新房的墙壁加了隔层。

examples.text_en: Air can work as a poor insulator in the home.
examples.text_zh: 在家庭中，空气可以算是一种很差的绝缘体。

examples.text_en: They used an insulator on the old power line.
examples.text_zh: 他们在旧的电力线上使用了绝缘体。

examples.text_en: His insulting words made the whole group feel very bad.
examples.text_zh: 他那些侮辱人的话让整个团队都很难受。

examples.text_en: She found his words insulting and left the room at once.
examples.text_zh: 她觉得他的话是在侮辱人，于是立刻离开了房间。

examples.text_en: The two sides faced an insuperable wall between them.
examples.text_zh: 双方之间隔着一道无法逾越的高墙。

examples.text_en: Their differences were insuperable and could not be changed.
examples.text_zh: 他们的分歧无法克服，也改变不了。

examples.text_en: The insurgent group took control of the small town.
examples.text_zh: 起义的团体控制了这座小镇。

examples.text_en: They fought against the insurgent forces for many weeks.
examples.text_zh: 他们与叛军战斗了许多个星期。

examples.text_en: The problem seemed insurmountable to the young team.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题在年轻的团队看来难以克服。

examples.text_en: They faced insurmountable problems in the first hard year.
examples.text_zh: 在艰难的第一年里，他们面临着无法逾越的困难。

examples.text_en: The insurrection spread across the country within a month.
examples.text_zh: 起义在一个月内蔓延到了全国。

examples.text_en: They tried to stop the insurrection with more police.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图用更多的警察来阻止这场暴动。

examples.text_en: The old house was still intact after the great fire.
examples.text_zh: 大火之后，那栋老房子依然完好无损。

examples.text_en: He kept the book intact for more than ten years.
examples.text_zh: 他把这本书完好地保存了十多年。

examples.text_en: His daily intake of water was far too low.
examples.text_zh: 他每天的水摄入量太低了。

examples.text_en: The intake of air through the old door was low.
examples.text_zh: 通过那扇旧门进入的空气很少。

examples.text_en: The intangibility of the idea made it hard to understand.
examples.text_zh: 这个想法难以捉摸，让人很难理解。

examples.text_en: He was lost in the intangibility of his own words.
examples.text_zh: 他迷失在自己话语的难以把握之中。

examples.text_en: Their fear was intangible but very real to them.
examples.text_zh: 他们的恐惧虽然无形，对他们却非常真实。

examples.text_en: He talked of an intangible power that moved the world.
examples.text_zh: 他谈到一种推动世界运行的无形力量。

examples.text_en: Practice is an integral part of learning a new language.
examples.text_zh: 练习是学习一门新语言不可分割的一部分。

examples.text_en: The two parts form one integral whole in this system.
examples.text_zh: 在这个系统中，这两个部分构成一个整体。

examples.text_en: The school offers an integrated program for young children.
examples.text_zh: 学校为幼儿提供一套综合课程。

examples.text_en: Their team is well integrated and works without any problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们的团队配合良好，工作起来没有什么问题。

examples.text_en: His intellect made him the best in the small group.
examples.text_zh: 他的才智使他在这个小组中出类拔萃。

examples.text_en: She used her intellect to face the hard problem.
examples.text_zh: 她用自己的才智来面对这个难题。

examples.text_en: He was intellectually strong but not very social.
examples.text_zh: 他在智力上很强，但不太善于社交。

examples.text_en: The work is intellectually hard and takes a long time.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作很费脑力，需要很长时间。

examples.text_en: His answer was clear and intelligible to everyone there.
examples.text_zh: 他的回答清晰易懂，在场的每个人都明白。

examples.text_en: Please make your words intelligible to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 请把你的话说得让整个团队都能理解。

examples.text_en: The two sides will intensify the fight over the land.
examples.text_zh: 双方将加强在土地问题上的争斗。

examples.text_en: A hard year can intensify the problems of a poor country.
examples.text_zh: 艰难的一年会加剧一个贫穷国家的问题。

examples.text_en: The intensity of the light made her turn away.
examples.text_zh: 强烈的光线让她转过头去。

examples.text_en: He talked with great intensity about the coming change.
examples.text_zh: 他非常激动地谈论着即将到来的变化。

examples.text_en: The school offers an intensive program for new people.
examples.text_zh: 学校为新来的人开设了强化课程。

examples.text_en: They went through two weeks of intensive training.
examples.text_zh: 他们经历了两周的集中训练。

examples.text_en: His mistake was not small but quite intentional.
examples.text_zh: 他的错误不是小失误，而是有意为之。

examples.text_en: The loss was intentional and done for a clear reason.
examples.text_zh: 这次的损失是有意造成的，为的是某个明确的原因。

examples.text_en: They will inter the old man near his family.
examples.text_zh: 他们将把这位老人安葬在他的家人附近。

examples.text_en: The people came to inter the dead after the war.
examples.text_zh: 战后，人们前来安葬死者。

examples.text_en: Good interaction between the two teams helped the whole project.
examples.text_zh: 两个团队之间的良好互动帮助了整个项目。

examples.text_en: We studied the interaction of light with the air and water.
examples.text_zh: 我们研究了光与空气和水的相互作用。

examples.text_en: The new program is interactive and fun for young children.
examples.text_zh: 这个新程序具有互动性，对幼儿来说很有趣。

examples.text_en: They held an interactive meeting between the two groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们在两个群体之间举行了一次互动会议。

examples.text_en: She asked him to intercede for her with the group.
examples.text_zh: 她请他在团队面前为自己说情。

examples.text_en: No one would intercede for the poor man.
examples.text_zh: 没有人愿意为这个可怜的人说情。

examples.text_en: The police tried to intercept the car before it left.
examples.text_zh: 警方试图在那辆车离开前拦截它。

examples.text_en: They could intercept the words from the other side.
examples.text_zh: 他们能从另一边截获这些话。

examples.text_en: The intercessor helped the two sides find a way out.
examples.text_zh: 这位调解人帮助双方找到了出路。

examples.text_en: They called on an old intercessor to end the fight.
examples.text_zh: 他们请来一位老调解人来结束这场争斗。

examples.text_en: The two parts are interchangeable and work on either side.
examples.text_zh: 这两个部件可以互换，两边都能用。

examples.text_en: In this system, the two words are almost interchangeable.
examples.text_zh: 在这个系统中，这两个词几乎可以互换。

examples.text_en: These lines interconnect the whole city with the small towns.
examples.text_zh: 这些线路把整座城市与周边小镇连接起来。

examples.text_en: The two systems interconnect and share the same data.
examples.text_zh: 这两个系统互相连接，共用同一份数据。

examples.text_en: The interconnecting rooms made the old house feel huge.
examples.text_zh: 这些相连的房间让那栋老房子显得很大。

examples.text_en: They built a set of interconnecting lines across the land.
examples.text_zh: 他们修建了一组横贯土地的互连线路。

examples.text_en: Their daily intercourse made the two groups close friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们日常的交往让两个群体成了好朋友。

examples.text_en: He enjoyed the free intercourse between old friends.
examples.text_zh: 他很享受老朋友之间自由的交流。

examples.text_en: The interdependence of the two groups grew over the years.
examples.text_zh: 这两个群体之间的相互依赖逐年加深。

examples.text_en: Modern life shows the interdependence of people and systems.
examples.text_zh: 现代生活体现了人与体系之间的相互依赖。

examples.text_en: The two countries are interdependent in trade.
examples.text_zh: 这两个国家在贸易上相互依赖。

examples.text_en: People and the earth are interdependent in many ways.
examples.text_zh: 人和地球在许多方面相互依存。

examples.text_en: The court will interdict the use of the old land.
examples.text_zh: 法院将禁止那块旧土地的使用。

examples.text_en: They tried to interdict the use of money by the group.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图禁止这个团体使用资金。

examples.text_en: The school started an interdisciplinary program for young people.
examples.text_zh: 学校为年轻人开设了一个跨学科项目。

examples.text_en: Their work is interdisciplinary and brings together many fields.
examples.text_zh: 他们的工作是跨学科的，汇集了许多领域。

examples.text_en: He took the interim job until a better one came.
examples.text_zh: 他接受了这份临时工作，直到有更好的出现。

examples.text_en: The interim rules will stay in place for one month.
examples.text_zh: 这些临时规定将维持一个月。

examples.text_en: They interlace the two kinds of line into one.
examples.text_zh: 他们把两种线交织成一股。

examples.text_en: She will interlace different words in the picture.
examples.text_zh: 她将在图画中交差错落不同的文字。

examples.text_en: The two parts interlock and hold the whole thing together.
examples.text_zh: 这两个部件相互咬合，把整个东西固定在一起。

examples.text_en: These boxes interlock to form one strong wall.
examples.text_zh: 这些箱子相互连锁，构成一堵坚固的墙。

examples.text_en: The interlocking parts made the old car very strong.
examples.text_zh: 这些连锁的部件让那辆旧车非常坚固。

examples.text_en: They built an interlocking system of lines and roads.
examples.text_zh: 他们建成了一个由线路和道路组成的连锁系统。

examples.text_en: His interlocutor asked a hard question about the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他的对话者就新计划问了一个难题。

examples.text_en: The two interlocutors talked for hours about the same thing.
examples.text_zh: 两位谈话者就同一件事谈了好几个小时。

examples.text_en: He tried to interlope in a business that was not his.
examples.text_zh: 他试图介入一桩不属于他的生意。

examples.text_en: They would not let a man interlope into their group.
examples.text_zh: 他们不让一个外人擅自闯入他们的团体。

examples.text_en: The interloper walked into the room without any fear.
examples.text_zh: 这个闯入者毫无惧色地走进了房间。

examples.text_en: They saw him as an interloper and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他看作外人，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: There was a short interlude between the two parts.
examples.text_zh: 两部分之间有一段简短的幕间。

examples.text_en: The song was a happy interlude in the long day.
examples.text_zh: 这首歌成了漫长一天中一段愉快的插曲。

examples.text_en: An intermediary helped the two sides make a deal.
examples.text_zh: 一位中间人帮助双方达成了协议。

examples.text_en: They acted as an intermediary between the two big groups.
examples.text_zh: 他们在两个大团体之间充当中间人。

examples.text_en: The meeting felt interminable and went on all night.
examples.text_zh: 会议漫长得仿佛没有尽头，一直开到深夜。

examples.text_en: We waited through an interminable line of cars.
examples.text_zh: 我们在望不到头的车流中等待着。

examples.text_en: The two kinds of music intermingle in this new song.
examples.text_zh: 这两种音乐在这首新歌里交融在一起。

examples.text_en: People from many places intermingle in the big city.
examples.text_zh: 来自许多地方的人在这座大城市里混杂相处。

examples.text_en: The intermittent light made it hard to read at night.
examples.text_zh: 忽明忽暗的灯光让人在夜里难以阅读。

examples.text_en: He could hear the intermittent sound of the old car.
examples.text_zh: 他能听见那辆旧车断断续续的声响。

examples.text_en: The internecine fight left both groups poor and small.
examples.text_zh: 这场自相残杀的争斗让两个群体都变得贫穷弱小。

examples.text_en: Years of internecine war changed the whole country.
examples.text_zh: 多年的内斗改变了整个国家。

examples.text_en: Good interpersonal interaction helps people work well together.
examples.text_zh: 良好的人际互动有助于人们很好地合作。

examples.text_en: They studied interpersonal relationships at home and at work.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究了家庭和工作中的人际关系。
